WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "customer_id" AS "CUSTOMER_ID"
    FROM "shop"."customer_versions"
  ),
  "menura_2_filter" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
    WHERE "CUSTOMER_ID" IS NOT NULL
  ),
  "menura_3_aggregate" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
      CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS "menura.row_count"
    FROM "menura_2_filter"
    GROUP BY 1
  ),
  "menura_4_filter" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "menura.row_count"
    FROM "menura_3_aggregate"
    WHERE "menura.row_count" > 1
  ),
  "menura_5_project" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "menura.row_count" AS "row_count"
    FROM "menura_4_filter"
  )
SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "row_count"
FROM "menura_5_project"

WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "customer_id" AS "CUSTOMER_ID"
    FROM "shop"."sales"
  ),
  "menura_2_filter" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
    WHERE "CUSTOMER_ID" IS NOT NULL
  ),
  "menura_3_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "customer_id" AS "SALE_CUSTOMER_ANY.CUSTOMER_ID"
    FROM "shop"."customer_versions"
  ),
  "menura_4_join" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "SALE_CUSTOMER_ANY.CUSTOMER_ID"
    FROM "menura_2_filter"
    LEFT JOIN "menura_3_scan" ON "menura_2_filter"."CUSTOMER_ID" = "menura_3_scan"."SALE_CUSTOMER_ANY.CUSTOMER_ID"
  ),
  "menura_5_filter" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "SALE_CUSTOMER_ANY.CUSTOMER_ID"
    FROM "menura_4_join"
    WHERE "SALE_CUSTOMER_ANY.CUSTOMER_ID" IS NULL
  ),
  "menura_6_project" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID"
    FROM "menura_5_filter"
  )
SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID"
FROM "menura_6_project"

WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "customer_id" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "valid_from" AS "VALID_FROM",
      "valid_to" AS "VALID_TO"
    FROM "shop"."customer_versions"
  ),
  "menura_2_bounds" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "VALID_FROM",
      "VALID_TO",
      "VALID_FROM" AS "menura.from",
      NULLIF("VALID_TO", CAST('2099-12-31' AS DATE)) AS "menura.to",
      row_number() OVER (ORDER BY "CUSTOMER_ID", "VALID_FROM", "VALID_TO") AS "menura.row"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
  ),
  "menura_3_overlaps" AS (
    SELECT
      "menura_row"."menura.row" AS "menura.row"
    FROM "menura_2_bounds" AS "menura_row"
    JOIN "menura_2_bounds" AS "menura_other" ON "menura_row"."menura.row" <> "menura_other"."menura.row" AND "menura_row"."CUSTOMER_ID" IS NOT NULL AND "menura_row"."CUSTOMER_ID" = "menura_other"."CUSTOMER_ID" AND "menura_row"."menura.from" IS NOT NULL AND ("menura_row"."menura.to" IS NULL OR "menura_row"."menura.from" < "menura_row"."menura.to") AND "menura_other"."menura.from" IS NOT NULL AND ("menura_other"."menura.to" IS NULL OR "menura_other"."menura.from" < "menura_other"."menura.to") AND ("menura_other"."menura.to" IS NULL OR "menura_row"."menura.from" < "menura_other"."menura.to") AND ("menura_row"."menura.to" IS NULL OR "menura_other"."menura.from" < "menura_row"."menura.to")
    GROUP BY 1
  )
SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "VALID_FROM" AS "VALID_FROM",
  "VALID_TO" AS "VALID_TO",
  'invalid_interval' AS "violation"
FROM "menura_2_bounds"
WHERE "menura.from" IS NOT NULL AND "menura.to" IS NOT NULL AND "menura.from" >= "menura.to"
UNION ALL
SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "VALID_FROM" AS "VALID_FROM",
  "VALID_TO" AS "VALID_TO",
  'overlap' AS "violation"
FROM "menura_2_bounds"
WHERE "menura.row" IN (SELECT "menura.row" FROM "menura_3_overlaps")

WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "customer_id" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "tier_from" AS "TIER_FROM",
      "tier_to" AS "TIER_TO"
    FROM "shop"."customer_tiers"
  ),
  "menura_2_days" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "TIER_FROM",
      "TIER_TO",
      CAST(("TIER_FROM") AT TIME ZONE CAST($1 AS VARCHAR) AS DATE) AS "menura.from_day",
      CAST(("TIER_TO") AT TIME ZONE CAST($1 AS VARCHAR) AS DATE) AS "menura.to_day",
      row_number() OVER (ORDER BY "CUSTOMER_ID", "TIER_FROM", "TIER_TO") AS "menura.row"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
  ),
  "menura_3_overlaps" AS (
    SELECT
      "menura_row"."menura.row" AS "menura.row"
    FROM "menura_2_days" AS "menura_row"
    JOIN "menura_2_days" AS "menura_other" ON "menura_row"."menura.row" <> "menura_other"."menura.row" AND "menura_row"."CUSTOMER_ID" IS NOT NULL AND "menura_row"."CUSTOMER_ID" = "menura_other"."CUSTOMER_ID" AND "menura_row"."menura.from_day" IS NOT NULL AND ("menura_row"."menura.to_day" IS NULL OR "menura_row"."menura.from_day" <= "menura_row"."menura.to_day") AND "menura_other"."menura.from_day" IS NOT NULL AND ("menura_other"."menura.to_day" IS NULL OR "menura_other"."menura.from_day" <= "menura_other"."menura.to_day") AND ("menura_other"."menura.to_day" IS NULL OR "menura_row"."menura.from_day" <= "menura_other"."menura.to_day") AND ("menura_row"."menura.to_day" IS NULL OR "menura_other"."menura.from_day" <= "menura_row"."menura.to_day")
    GROUP BY 1
  )
SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "TIER_FROM" AS "TIER_FROM",
  "TIER_TO" AS "TIER_TO",
  'invalid_interval' AS "violation"
FROM "menura_2_days"
WHERE "menura.from_day" IS NOT NULL AND "menura.to_day" IS NOT NULL AND "menura.from_day" > "menura.to_day"
UNION ALL
SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "TIER_FROM" AS "TIER_FROM",
  "TIER_TO" AS "TIER_TO",
  'overlap' AS "violation"
FROM "menura_2_days"
WHERE "menura.row" IN (SELECT "menura.row" FROM "menura_3_overlaps")

WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "customer_id" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "sold_on" AS "SOLD_ON"
    FROM "shop"."sales"
  ),
  "menura_2_filter" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "SOLD_ON"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
    WHERE ("CUSTOMER_ID" IS NOT NULL) AND ("SOLD_ON" IS NOT NULL)
  ),
  "menura_3_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "customer_id" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "valid_from" AS "VALID_FROM",
      "valid_to" AS "VALID_TO"
    FROM "shop"."customer_versions"
  ),
  "menura_4_rows" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "SOLD_ON",
      row_number() OVER (ORDER BY "CUSTOMER_ID", "SOLD_ON") AS "menura.row"
    FROM "menura_2_filter"
  ),
  "menura_5_covered" AS (
    SELECT
      "menura_row"."menura.row" AS "menura.row"
    FROM "menura_4_rows" AS "menura_row"
    JOIN "menura_3_scan" AS "menura_version" ON "menura_row"."CUSTOMER_ID" = "menura_version"."CUSTOMER_ID" AND "menura_version"."VALID_FROM" IS NOT NULL AND "menura_version"."VALID_FROM" <= "menura_row"."SOLD_ON" AND (NULLIF("menura_version"."VALID_TO", CAST('2099-12-31' AS DATE)) IS NULL OR "menura_row"."SOLD_ON" < NULLIF("menura_version"."VALID_TO", CAST('2099-12-31' AS DATE)))
    GROUP BY 1
  )
SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "SOLD_ON" AS "SOLD_ON"
FROM "menura_4_rows"
WHERE "menura.row" NOT IN (SELECT "menura.row" FROM "menura_5_covered")

WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "customer_id" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "visited_at" AS "VISITED_AT"
    FROM "shop"."visits"
  ),
  "menura_2_filter" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "VISITED_AT"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
    WHERE ("CUSTOMER_ID" IS NOT NULL) AND ("VISITED_AT" IS NOT NULL)
  ),
  "menura_3_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "customer_id" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "tier_from" AS "TIER_FROM",
      "tier_to" AS "TIER_TO"
    FROM "shop"."customer_tiers"
  ),
  "menura_4_rows" AS (
    SELECT
      "CUSTOMER_ID",
      "VISITED_AT",
      row_number() OVER (ORDER BY "CUSTOMER_ID", "VISITED_AT") AS "menura.row"
    FROM "menura_2_filter"
  ),
  "menura_5_covered" AS (
    SELECT
      "menura_row"."menura.row" AS "menura.row"
    FROM "menura_4_rows" AS "menura_row"
    JOIN "menura_3_scan" AS "menura_version" ON "menura_row"."CUSTOMER_ID" = "menura_version"."CUSTOMER_ID" AND "menura_version"."TIER_FROM" IS NOT NULL AND "menura_version"."TIER_FROM" <= "menura_row"."VISITED_AT" AND ("menura_version"."TIER_TO" IS NULL OR "menura_row"."VISITED_AT" <= "menura_version"."TIER_TO")
    GROUP BY 1
  )
SELECT
  "CUSTOMER_ID" AS "CUSTOMER_ID",
  "VISITED_AT" AS "VISITED_AT"
FROM "menura_4_rows"
WHERE "menura.row" NOT IN (SELECT "menura.row" FROM "menura_5_covered")
